title: Refactor the module before adding more orchestration logic
desired_outcome: Break oversized services and UI files into coherent authoring, runtime, projection, policy, and integration slices.
acceptance: No single service or component file that owns core orchestration exceeds a maintainability threshold
runtime, definition authoring, projection, and policy concerns are separated
behavior remains covered by tests.
tests_to_add_or_update: Refactor-safety regression tests around save/publish/start/transition/workbench projection.
risk_notes: Do not change canonical behavior during the split beyond bug fixes already covered by tests.

title: Complete the canonical definition model
desired_outcome: Add structured transitions, governance profile, interface contracts, decision-right rules, input-quality rules, and exception/variant entities.
primary_touchpoints: new domain files under Definitions/ and Governance/
acceptance: Published processes can express transitions with conditions/defaults/priorities
governance profile and interface contracts are structured
graph validation rejects unreachable or orphaned states.
tests_to_add_or_update: Unit tests for graph validation and publish validation
risk_notes: Preserve existing data with additive migrations and compatibility mapping from legacy text fields.

title: Replace destructive child persistence with stable diff-based saves
desired_outcome: Process child rows keep stable identities and only changed records mutate.
primary_touchpoints: ProcessesService.cs or replacement definition persistence services
acceptance: Editing a definition no longer recreates all roles/steps/assignments/artifact expectations
external references remain stable across saves.
tests_to_add_or_update: Integration tests verifying child IDs remain stable across non-structural edits.
risk_notes: Backward compatibility with existing editor payloads must be retained.

title: Rebuild runtime orchestration over canonical transitions
desired_outcome: Runtime activation, branching, and completion are driven by ProcessTransition and policy evaluation instead of linear sequence.
primary_touchpoints: ProcessesService.Runtime.cs or new Runtime/ orchestration services
acceptance: Parallel/conditional/default flows can be activated correctly
invalid transitions are rejected deterministically
runtime status reflects graph semantics.
tests_to_add_or_update: Unit tests for branching and guarded transitions
integration tests for multi-path process runs.
risk_notes: Avoid changing shell/MCP contracts until orchestration behavior is stable behind service boundaries.

title: Add baton handoffs, governed triage, and normalized work brief snapshots
desired_outcome: Responsibility transfer and dispatch decisions become first-class runtime artifacts with full audit context.
acceptance: Each handoff records source role, target role, brief snapshot, completion context, and journal link
direct agent-to-agent bypass requires explicit override evidence.
tests_to_add_or_update: Integration tests for human-to-agent, agent-to-human, and triage-controlled routing scenarios.
risk_notes: Keep work briefs immutable once attached to a handoff or activation.

title: Implement approval and escalation policy engine
desired_outcome: Approvals, supervisory escalation, conflict prevention, override records, and timeout handling are enforced in code.
acceptance: A step can pause for approval, route to a target human or supervisory role, prevent self-approval/conflicts, and resume with auditable evidence.
tests_to_add_or_update: Approval conflict tests, escalation route tests, explicit override tests.
risk_notes: Do not leave policy hidden in free-text summaries once this task lands.

title: Add hard agent guardrails and external executor correlations
desired_outcome: Future agents can be governed by capability checks, permission narrowing, evaluation records, and durable external runtime correlations.
acceptance: External executor/session/log/metric IDs can be linked back to ProcessRun and ProcessStepRun
permission/approval policy is enforced in code
no direct compile-time AgentFramework contamination is introduced.
tests_to_add_or_update: Integration tests for bridge adapters, permission narrowing, and approval-required external actions.
risk_notes: CRM-HR and Workspace must remain canonical for identities/templates/providers.

title: Propagate interventions into project structure
desired_outcome: Blocked, waiting-approval, refused, failed, and human-decision-required states create actionable project structure nodes.
primary_touchpoints: SharedKernel project object contracts if needed
acceptance: Decision nodes and WorkItem nodes appear under the process run when human intervention is required and are updated as process state changes.
tests_to_add_or_update: Workbench integration tests for intervention node creation, update, and closure.
risk_notes: Keep projection one-way; project structure must not become a second canonical process store.

title: Expose journal, replay, and live overlay from the same canonical runtime
desired_outcome: Operators can inspect journal chronology, replay context, and live canvas overlays without alternate mutation paths.
acceptance: Run detail includes journal timeline
MCP exposes journal access
canvas overlay shows wait reason, approval state, and last baton movement from journal-backed projections.
tests_to_add_or_update: Integration tests for journal retrieval and overlay consistency.

title: Expand telemetry, capacity, conformance, and feedback
desired_outcome: The module can measure lead time, queue time, approval wait, blocked time, rework, capacity, bottlenecks, and outcome/feedback signals meaningfully.
acceptance: Dashboards segment by process, owner, customer, project, interface, and criticality
customer/internal-customer feedback can be attached to completed runs.
tests_to_add_or_update: Analytics query tests and feedback persistence tests.
risk_notes: Do not present raw activity counts as success KPIs without outcome context.

title: Add conformance clustering and improvement governance
desired_outcome: Repeated unofficial loops, bypasses, and friction patterns become structured improvement and governance signals.
acceptance: Deviation clusters can be reviewed and converted into approved variants, fixes, or policy-breach investigations with privacy controls.
tests_to_add_or_update: Cluster-detection tests and governance routing tests.
risk_notes: Avoid creating an unmanaged rumor registry.

title: Converge role/agent templates with CRM-HR and add staffing gap workflows
desired_outcome: Reusable templates and staffing gap resolution are governed canonically outside the process module while process versions snapshot references safely.
acceptance: Process roles can reference governed template versions
unresolved gaps can open staffing/recruiting/agent-sourcing work without losing process context.
tests_to_add_or_update: Cross-module integration tests for template reference resolution and staffing gap links.
risk_notes: Do not duplicate durable identity or template ownership in Processes.

title: Add Mermaid import/export and controlled seeding adapters
desired_outcome: Processes can be imported/exported more portably without making external formats canonical.
acceptance: Published processes can export JSON and Mermaid
imports record explicit warnings for non-round-trippable semantics.
risk_notes: Maintain process tables as the single source of truth.

title: Add change governance, communication, and portfolio guidance
desired_outcome: Process portfolio changes become governed, acknowledged, and tiered by criticality and impact.
acceptance: Change proposals capture reason, impact, risk, rollout, approvals, and acknowledgements
publish/retire operations can require governance approval based on criticality.
tests_to_add_or_update: Governed publish/retire tests and acknowledgement workflow tests.
risk_notes: Keep business governance explicit and reviewable, not hidden in operational notes.

title: Strengthen test matrix and runtime hardening for production control-plane use
desired_outcome: The module is defensible under concurrency, external executor integration, and projection-heavy operational use.
acceptance: Unit, integration, component, MCP, and concurrency tests cover the final canonical graph, approvals, handoffs, projections, and bridge behavior
runtime rows use concurrency protection.
tests_to_add_or_update: This task is itself the test and hardening expansion.
risk_notes: Do not declare agent readiness before this phase is green.
